value.rationale: Determines the missing dihedral reflection character, extending already known cyclic action in a natural infinite family. Reflection quotients for n congruent to four mod eight have different rational top Betti ranks for their two axis classes; this is invisible in sphere multiplicities or the cyclic representation. An explicit fixed-path transfer method is reusable.
